name: Crack a fetch on turn 1-2 for a land that unlocks a hand card
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks has had first refusal, play a fetch from hand (Misty Rainforest, Verdant Catacombs, Windswept Heath, Wooded Foothills) and crack it for whatever library land would unlock some other hand card - a library Forest unlocking Birds of Paradise. Every fetch here can search for Forest, this deck's core colour, so the prefer tier searches_for_any:[Forest] does not discriminate among them (every candidate matches it); ties any then breaks the remaining tie by sorted name. This play's own true key now reads unlocks_by_basic_search rather than the broader unlocks_by_search (item 4, 2026-09-14 review batch), and the move's own play_land.card select and activate.source prefer tier follow suit for consistency - a fetch whose only reach is a non-basic shockland no longer fires this play at all, matching open-shock-unlocks' own narrowed false key. That leaves a gap in principle (a hand with no direct shock and a fetch reaching only a non-basic): every fetch here can also reach this deck's own two Forest basics, and both shocklands (Overgrown Tomb, Temple Garden) themselves carry the Forest subtype, so the gap only opens once both Forest copies are already out of the library - unreachable within a turn 1-2 opening hand plus a couple of draws from a 60-card deck running 2 Forests among 16 lands. Accepted without a dedicated fetch-for-a-shock play (unlike prowess, whose only blue source is non-basic and needs one); see docs/DECK-PIPELINE.md's Known limits. The activate move's own source carries a prefer:[{unlocks_by_basic_search:true}] tier of its own, so a second untapped fetch already sitting on the battlefield from an earlier turn (declined by open-land-idle, which holds a fetch rather than cracking it) is never the one cracked in place of the fetch this turn's own land drop just played - a bare tapped:false selector alone takes whichever untapped fetch sorts first by name, which need not be the one whose own search reaches the unlock. Its own choose_cards pick prefers a basic first, then a shockland, paying life only when the fetch's own find needs it. Stands down once open-land-unlocks would already fire, at 7 life or less, and once the library is down to 5 cards or fewer. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
